name: PD 472 was established by Ordinance No. 23115, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 14,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 472 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 472 was established by Ordinance No. 23115, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 14, 1997. Ordinance No. 23115 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 23115 was amended by Ordinance No. 23757, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 13, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23115; 23757; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 472 is established on property generally located at the eastern terminus of Marquette Street and south of the proposed Caruth Haven Lane right-of-way. The size of PD 472 is approximately 3.73 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 472A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Temporary construction or sales office.

(b) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area.

(c) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component in Section 51A-4.209(3.1) is not met.] -- Single family.

(d) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front, side, and rear yard. No minimum front, side, and rear yard setback.

(b) Density. A maximum of 18 dwelling units are permitted on the Property.

(c) Floor area. No maximum floor area ratio.

(d) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(e) Stories. No maximum number of stories.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent.

(g) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 3,250 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Parking for a single family use must be provided at a ratio of two off-street parking spaces per dwelling unit.

(b) For all other uses, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off- street parking requirements for each use.

(c) Except as provided below, consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally.

(d) A parking space must be located a minimum of 10 feet from the right-of-way line adjacent to a street or alley if the space is located in an enclosed structure and if the space faces upon or can be entered directly from the street or alley. This subsection controls over the provisions of Section 51A-4.301(a)(9). (Ord. Nos. 23757; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Electrical Service For Single Family Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.110. ELECTRICAL SERVICE FOR SINGLE FAMILY USES.

A lot for a single family use may be supplied by not more than one electrical utility service, and metered by not more than one electrical meter. The board of adjustment may grant a special exception to authorize more than one electrical meter on a lot when, in the opinion of the board, the special exception will:

(1) not be contrary to the public interest;

(2) not adversely affect neighboring properties; and

(3) not be used to conduct a use not permitted. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.111. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress for multifamily uses must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.112. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Tree Preservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.113. TREE PRESERVATION.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b) below, the regulations contained in Division 51A- 10.130, “Tree Preservation,” apply to this PD.

(b) Tree removal applications may be approved prior to the issuance of a building permit on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.114. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Barrier free ramps must be installed simultaneously with the paving of the streets on the Property.

(b) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(c) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.116. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-472.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 472 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. Nos. 23115; 26042)
